description: June 8 birthday meaning: Gemini decan 2, birthday number 8, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a June 8 birthday falls in Gemini, in the second decan, with Mercury as the sign's ruler and Venus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 8. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Gemini is mutable and air.

sections.heading: The June 8 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: June 8th birthdays put Gemini's versatility to work. Eight, the number of authority and material results, combines with the Venus decan's gift for relationships, seventeen degrees into the sign. The result is traditionally pictured as a persuasive operator, comfortable in sales, media or negotiation. Charm is the tool; ambition is the engine; integrity tends to be the steering.

Astronomically, June 8 puts the Sun near 17° Gemini in most years, inside the second ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Venus. Venus, which governs Libra, colours the middle decan of Gemini, giving the Twins' restless mind a social and aesthetic polish. Early-June birthdays are commonly linked with charming conversationalists who notice how something is said as much as what is said. They tend to enjoy collaboration, matching ideas or people, and finding the elegant version of an argument. The Libran thread can make conflict uncomfortable, so a sharp opinion may be softened until it quietly disappears. Their strength is diplomacy with substance: helping groups talk to each other while keeping the exchange genuinely curious rather than merely pleasant.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for June 8
paragraphs: A birthday on the 8th gives a birthday number of 8 with nothing to reduce. In numerology the day of birth works as a supporting number, a practical aptitude that colours the Life Path. The 8, drawn as two stacked loops, is traditionally linked with balance between the material and inner worlds, and with authority, organisation and ambition. People born on the 8th are often seen as capable managers of money, time and teams. They may also be hard on themselves when results lag. Generosity with the influence they build is commonly regarded as the 8's best expression.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a June 8 birthday gives Life Path 6 for 1990, 7 for 2000, 8 for 2010 and 9 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous June 8 birthdays
paragraphs: A June birthday falls at the height of northern summer, around the longest days of the year, while in the southern hemisphere it marks the darkest stretch near the winter solstice. Gemini covers most of the month, with Cancer beginning around June 21. June is month 6 in numerology, a number of care, responsibility and home, which foreshadows the Cancerian turn at the month's end. June 8 is the 159th day of the year (160th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Cancer, is usually complete within 14 days, by June 22.

By June 8 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a June 8 birthday are Frank Lloyd Wright (1867), Tim Berners-Lee (1955) and Robert Schumann (1810).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is June 8?
faq.answer: June 8 is Gemini in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Gemini, which tradition links with Venus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on June 8?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On June 8 the Life Path is 3 in 1960, 22 in 1970, 5 in 1980, 6 in 1990, 7 in 2000, 8 in 2010 and 9 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 8 for everyone born on the 8th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on June 8?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by June 8, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on June 8?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on June 8 include Frank Lloyd Wright (1867), Tim Berners-Lee (1955) and Robert Schumann (1810). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
